content.overview: The producers who are active Members may, if so provided in the articles, have special rights, and the Producer Company may issue appropriate instruments to them in respect of such special rights. Instruments issued under this section shall, after obtaining approval of the Board, be transferable to any other active Member of that Producer Company. ‘Special right’ means any right relating to supply of additional produce by the active Member or any other right relating to his produce which may be conferred upon him by the Board.
content.glance: Active Members may have special rights (if articles provide); instruments transferable only to another active Member with Board approval; special right relates to additional produce or other produce-related right conferred by the Board.
content.study: Section 378ZC allows active Members to hold special rights when the articles so provide. The company may issue instruments for those rights. Transfer of such instruments requires Board approval and may only be to another active Member. The statutory explanation confines a special right to rights relating to supply of additional produce or other produce-related rights conferred by the Board.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Active Members may, if the articles so provide, have special rights; instruments for those rights are transferable only to another active Member with Board approval.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378ZC
examples.body: An active Member who supplies additional produce receives a special-right instrument under the articles; with Board approval the instrument is transferred to another active Member.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378ZC?
hypotheticals.analysis: It permits special rights for active Members (if articles provide) and restricts transfer of the related instruments to other active Members with Board approval.

rows.right: Transferability of shares (s. 378ZD) or share capital (s. 378ZB)

misconceptions.trap: Treating special rights as freely transferable to non-members.
misconceptions.correction: Instruments under s. 378ZC are transferable only to another active Member and only with Board approval.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378ZC be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Check articles for special rights. II. Confirm active-Member status and Board approval for transfer. III. Conclude.

revisionPoints: Special user rights — active Members only if articles provide; instruments transferable to active Member with Board approval
